# Bloub animation engine

This directory contains the framework-free SVG animation engine adapted from
[`jeremy-prt/bloub`](https://github.com/jeremy-prt/bloub) at commit
`b4bb3c1b5f93c7b87a2e8d620f667c4093d97749`.

The upstream project is Copyright (c) 2026 Jérémy Perret and licensed under the
MIT License. See `LICENSE` in this directory. Resumetrics uses the engine through
a React renderer and does not include the upstream Vue demo or export tooling.
